what: My 20 hand labels, made with LABELING-RULE.md v1.0 (commit b6b2b13) before any Claude call
how: Multiple choice in the Claude Code app on 2026-10-30, in three batches. For each of the ten postings the rule passes, I read its requirement lines (shown to me word for word, with any role line that says 'Lead') and the full posting on labels/SHEET.md, then picked a label and its reason. The ten postings the rule rejects fail part 1 of my labeling rule; I confirmed all ten as not relevant in one answer, and their 'check' field is copied from the rule's record. Claude Code prepared the excerpts and recorded my answers; it read the held-out postings while doing so.
